Project

Core timeline and output dimensions.

Schema 1

Diffusion Cadence

Choose how often AI redraws a frame. Camera movement continues on frames between diffusion passes.

Future-anchor mode refines skipped 3D frames after the next diffusion anchor is generated. It uses camera geometry and confidence-gated blending, not optical flow or an extra diffusion pass; only supported regions are blended.

Cadence 1 runs diffusion for every eligible frame.

For changing cadence, enter a schedule such as 0:(1), 24:(3), or edit the Diffusion Cadence track in Visual Timeline. The last frame is always a diffusion anchor if denoising is enabled.

Start Frame

Choose how frame 0 is created. This is the actual first frame of the diffusion animation.

Prompt Keyframes

Positive and negative prompts resolve into per-frame transition weights.

Create or load a project to edit prompt keyframes.

2D Motion Schedules

Classic Deforum-style affine motion. Zoom is a multiplicative factor per frame, so small changes compound quickly.

3D Camera Schedules

Depth-aware virtual camera controls. Signed translation and rotation values are resolved per frame; FOV controls perspective.

3D

Applying a preset replaces the six 3D motion schedules with constant per-frame values. It does not change FOV, depth settings, prompts, or LoRAs. Save to keep it.

Renderer status B5.1 preserves the legacy projection for direct comparisons. Select subpixel projection to improve edges; background-priority fill is experimental. For every 3D frame, Morphorum also saves a black/white disocclusion mask alongside frames for future repair. Start gently: Translation Z around ±0.02 to ±0.08 scene units and rotations around ±0.25° to ±1° per frame. Larger values compound quickly because each rendered frame becomes the next camera source.

Generation State

Model-independent animation controls. Adapter-specific interpretation comes later.

Camera Motion Preview

CPU-only 2D or 3D camera-motion preview from your uploaded image. No diffusion and no GPU model load.

Geometry only 3D mode simulates sequential depth warps and reports projected coverage and newly exposed pixels. The red overlay is only a preview aid. The uploaded reference does not change your real starting-frame mode or model.

Render the real diffusion sequence. Frame 0 comes from the selected Start Mode; each later frame transforms the previous rendered frame before img2img diffusion.

Animation Pipeline

One project flows from start-frame choice through schedules, previews, resumable diffusion frames, and final assembly.

TimelineFrames, FPS, dimensions
PromptsPositive + negative keyframes
MotionRaw 2D schedule strings
GenerationStrength, noise, steps, guidance, seeds
ModelStable indexed model reference
PersistenceAtomic human-readable project.json
ExpressionsSafe t/max_f math evaluation
InspectorResolved frame values + curve preview
2D TransformCumulative angle, zoom, translation
Motion PreviewCPU-only animated source-image preview
Img2Img LoopPrevious frame → transform → diffusion → next frame
ResumePer-frame manifest + interrupted render recovery
